objective: Describe the fixed top-winner, failed-opportunity, false-breakout, and severe-loss archetypes, then test whether breadth retains MFE-to-return capture information after fixed observable path, year, and exit-lineage controls.

sample.archetype_sample: all frozen completed cycles; breadth summaries are complete-case only and counts always report missing breadth
sample.controlled_sample: fixed MFE>=20% opportunity cycles with complete breadth composite, MFE, holding duration, days-to-MFE, entry year, exit reason, and endpoint
sample.missingness: endpoint deletion only; no imputation, clipping, normalization, post-exit extension, or zero-filling

fixed_archetypes.annual_top10_pnl: top 10 realized_pnl cycles inside exit execution year, ordered by realized_pnl descending then trade_id ascending
fixed_archetypes.annual_top20_pnl: top 20 realized_pnl cycles inside exit execution year with the same deterministic ordering
fixed_archetypes.global_top10_pnl: top 10 realized_pnl cycles over all blocks with the same deterministic ordering
fixed_archetypes.global_top20_pnl: top 20 realized_pnl cycles over all blocks with the same deterministic ordering

archetype_summaries: count and share of all cycles
MFE, MAE, return, realized P&L, holding duration, days-to-MFE fraction, 5/10/20-session path
entry-year, exit-year, breadth-tercile, and canonical-exit-reason composition

continuous_controls: within-controlled-sample percentile rank of days_to_mfe / max(holding_trading_days, 1)
controlled_model.estimator: Pearson correlation of predictor/outcome residuals after separate least-squares projections on the identical fixed design
controlled_model.loyo: repeat the identical model omitting each entry year 2018 through 2025

falsification.incremental_conversion_support: at least one fixed endpoint has direction-adjusted absolute partial-rank rho >= 0.10 and the expected sign in at least 7/8 LOYO estimates
falsification.entry_only_support: incremental_conversion_support fails while prior Phase 4/5 opportunity support remains intact
falsification.downside_gate_support: rejected unless higher breadth has negative severe-loss association with at least 7/8 same expected-sign LOYO estimates; Phase 5 is the frozen test and is not recomputed or redefined
falsification.exit_causality: never inferred because no counterfactual post-exit path is available

forbidden: new feature, alternative control set, interaction, or threshold search
new replay, post-exit price, exit counterfactual, or causal exit claim
